record.title: Inconsistent await handling of installPluginFromPath
record.detail: Lines 27-29 use a ternary expression where installPluginFromPath is not awaited but installPluginFromSource is awaited. If installPluginFromPath returns a Promise, the variable `dir` will be assigned a Promise instead of a string, causing console.log on line 30 to print the Promise object rather than the path. The pattern is: `parsed.kind === "local" ? installPluginFromPath(parsed.path, name, ts) : await installPluginFromSource(parsed, name, ts);` If both functions are async, installPluginFromPath must also be awaited.
record.fix: Change line 27-28 to: `const dir = parsed.kind === "local" ? await installPluginFromPath(parsed.path, name, ts) : await installPluginFromSource(parsed, name, ts);`
